description: Source code defining the OutgoingOAuthConnection model, related types, validation, sanitization, patching, and filtering functions for managing outgoing OAuth connections in Mattermost.

classes.name: OutgoingOAuthConnection
classes.description: Represents an outgoing OAuth connection with fields for credentials, URLs, grant type, and audiences.

classes.name: OutgoingOAuthConnectionGetConnectionsFilter
classes.description: Filter used to retrieve outgoing OAuth connections with pagination and audience filtering.

classes.name: OutgoingOAuthConnectionToken
classes.description: Represents an OAuth token with methods to format it for HTTP headers.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the OutgoingOAuthConnection object for required fields and correctness.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Removes sensitive information from the OutgoingOAuthConnection object.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Updates the OutgoingOAuthConnection with non-empty fields from another connection.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Initializes ID and timestamps before saving.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an ETag for caching based on ID and update timestamp.

methods.name: SetDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for the connection filter.

methods.name: ToURLValues
methods.description: Converts the filter to URL query parameters.

methods.name: AsHeaderValue
methods.description: Formats the OAuth token for HTTP Authorization header.

methods.name: HasValidGrantType
methods.description: Validates the grant type and associated credentials.
